source(output(
		EventID as integer,
		EventName as string,
		EventTypeID as integer,
		EventType as string,
		TriggerID as integer,
		Trigger as string,
		Staged as boolean,
		JobID as integer,
		JobName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT 	[JobID], 	[JobName], 	[EventID], 	[EventName], 	[EventTypeID], 	[EventType], 	[TriggerID], 	[Trigger], 	[Staged] FROM [Tidal].[Tidal_JobEvent] WHERE Staged = 0',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ERDBTidalJobEvent	source(output(
		JobId as integer,
		EventID as integer,
		EventTypeID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT        J.jobmst_id AS JobId, TRG.trgmst_id AS EventID, TJ.trgjob_type AS EventTypeID FROM            jobmst AS J INNER JOIN                          jobcls AS CLS ON CLS.jobcls_id = J.jobcls_id AND CLS.jobcls_name IN                              (SELECT        JobClassName                                FROM            ##JobClassFilter) INNER JOIN                          trgjob AS TJ ON TJ.jobmst_id = J.jobmst_id INNER JOIN                          trgmst AS TRG ON TRG.trgmst_id = TJ.trgmst_id WHERE        (J.jobmst_type > 1) AND (J.jobmst_prntname NOT LIKE \'%wastebasket%\') AND (J.jobmst_dirty <> \'X\')',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupAdmiraltrgmstLKPTABLE
ERDBTidalJobEvent,LookupAdmiraltrgmstLKPTABLE lookup(ERDBTidalJobEvent@EventID == LookupAdmiraltrgmstLKPTABLE@EventID && ERDBTidalJobEvent@EventTypeID == LookupAdmiraltrgmstLKPTABLE@EventTypeID && ERDBTidalJobEvent@JobID == LookupAdmiraltrgmstLKPTABLE@JobId,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LookupAdmiraltrgmst
LookupAdmiraltrgmst select(mapColumn(
		EventID = ERDBTidalJobEvent@EventID,
		EventName = EventName,
		EventTypeID = ERDBTidalJobEvent@EventTypeID,
		EventType = EventType,
		TriggerID = TriggerID,
		Trigger = Trigger,
		Staged = Staged,
		JobID = ERDBTidalJobEvent@JobID,
		JobName = JobName,
		JobId = ERDBTidalJobEvent@JobID
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LookupAdmiraltrgmstSelect
LookupAdmiraltrgmstSelect filter(!isMatch()) ~> FilterLookupAdmiraltrgmst
